title: Cash Reserve Ratio
definition: Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR) is the specified minimum fraction of the total deposits of customers that commercial banks have to hold as reserves either in cash with themselves or, more strictly in the Indian context, with the central bank (RBI).
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC Prelims (monetary policy instruments, banking operations, RBI acts) and Mains GS Paper 3 (mobilization of resources, monetary transmission, economic growth vs inflation control).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Cash Reserve Ratio.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Functions of the Reserve Bank of India
